rows.heading: What is actually on the two reels, frame by frame
The French took the registers, and the priest wrote down what that cost him
The bishop who signed this book names the archive the family's records are in
⚠⚠ The house-6 answer published yesterday was wrong — and the census refutes it in two lines
⭐ The census enters the same woman twice — which is the way to find who Joanna was
⚠ The pass was made and Joanna is not there — because the family's census pages are mostly empty
⚠ Neither bride was baptised here — and the parish they came from was already in this archive
⭐⭐ Both brides came from Gračišće — houses 4 and 5 — and the census said so in a column I never read
⭐⭐ The migration column, finished — Gologorica's exchange partner is Gračišće, by two to one
⚠ Reading the Gračišće house 5 page — which this archive had already read, and what checking it turned up
⭐⭐ The head of the direct line was not baptised at Gračišće — and in ten years of its baptisms the surname never appears
«NASTAVLJA SE» — the Gračišće baptism book stops in May 1808, as this archive's own errand already said
⭐⭐ A certificate loose in the book confirms the diocese — from a second parish, nine years earlier
⭐⭐⭐ «Josephus de Franceschi GOLLAGORICIENSIS» — the register says which village they came from, and it is the other one
⭐⭐⭐ Sixty-two years of Gračišće baptisms: six Defranceschi, every one a godparent, five of them «of Gologorica»
⭐⭐⭐ The Gračišće register certifies its own gaps — a visitor in 1732 found entries missing and ordered them written in
⭐⭐ The household the Defranceschi kept coming back to — six children of one Gračišće couple, and the three they were asked for
⭐⭐⭐ The sweep is finished — and the confirmation rolls at the back of the book, which the archive had listed and never read, hold no Defranceschi
⭐⭐⭐ The column nobody read: twenty Defranceschi at the Gračišće font, 1791–1808, every one of them «cives»
⭐⭐⭐ The renumbering is many-to-one — two old houses became one new house with two families, and the direction was backwards
⭐⭐⭐ 9 June 1774 — the marriage register nobody had opened names the archpriest, the bride's father, and a weaver
⭐⭐⭐ The 1862, 1894 and 1921 censuses — two of them carry their own indexes, one Grah in all three, and a surname changed BY DECREE OF THE PREFECT OF POLA
⭐⭐ The 1826 census swept end to end for the Grah: ONE of them in a hundred and twenty-one frames — and she is a «GRAH-MIŠAN»
⭐⭐⭐ The 1784–1880 baptism book has an INDEX nobody had opened — and its «G» is a clean nil for the Grah while its «D» hands over twelve siblings with the page of every baptism
⭐⭐⭐ CEROVLJE opened for the first time — and the GRAH are there, three households deep, under THREE forms of the name
⭐⭐⭐ The GRAH are found — a household at Gračišće, house 174, entered «Cives» — and a Defranceschi stood godmother to one of their children on a frame this archive had already cited
✔✔ Two Josephus rows adjudicated: ONE man, joined with «sameAs» — and the 1782 death the archive carried for a year does not exist
⭐⭐⭐ «Obijt JOSEPHUS DE FRANCESCHJ, MERCATOR, ætatis suæ annorum 64» — the question opened this afternoon is answered the same afternoon, and the trade is proved twice
✔✔✔ «LIBER BAPTIZATORUM II» IS FINISHED — all thirty-eight frames, 1764 to 1788, and its structure is nothing like a single book
⭐⭐⭐ A fourth child for the weaver's household, the trade still in the family fourteen years on — and «HELLENA UXOR JOSEPHI» in October 1787, which cannot be true
⭐⭐ For five years this parish kept TWO baptism registers at once — and the two entries for one child are not the same entry
⭐⭐⭐ «Domina Catharina Defranceschi nata SABLICH BUCCARENSIS» — three years earlier than the archive had her, in a third hand, and that hand writes S
⭐⭐⭐ «Ego JOANNES MATHIAS FRANCESCHI, CANONICUS et PAROCHUS Gollogoritiæ» — the book answers this morning's correction itself, in his own hand
⭐⭐⭐ «Josephi Defranceschi MERCATORIS» — a trade for the man whose whole row was once the word «Dominus», and the Carnia tie turns out to be a trade network
⭐⭐⭐ The girl who died at ten with no parents attached gets her baptism — and she was born in the NEXT PARISH, which is why every sweep of this village missed her
⭐⭐⭐ «Admodum R.do D.no CANONICO MATTHIA DEFRANCESCHI» — the canonry is seven years earlier than the archive had it, and the ladder published this morning has to come down
⭐⭐ A loose slip lying inside the book — a Cerovlje extract of 1793 — names the archpriest this archive published four hours ago, and explains a frame that looks like film debris
⭐⭐⭐ One opening, three months apart: «filius Leonardi» and «filius D.ni Josephi» — the parish tells the two Joannes Baptistas apart by their FATHERS, seventeen years before it does it by their wives
⭐⭐⭐ A row that was a census line and a tree year gets its baptism, its parents and a second forename — and an archpriest came over from Cerovlje to give it
⭐⭐⭐ The same priest writes «Supani Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi» three times in three years — and the sweep hands back the second construction it was promised
⭐⭐⭐ The first page of Liber II names a ŽUPAN of Gologorica in full — and puts the Defranceschi priest at a font four years before anyone knew he was there
⭐⭐⭐ The priest tells the two Joannes Baptistas apart himself, in one sentence, by their wives
⭐⭐⭐ The second baptism book — a wife, four children, a canon, and a daughter married into Castel Roč
✔ The whole of «Liber Baptizatorum III et Mortuorum II», swept — eight Defranceschi events out of a book nobody had opened
⭐⭐⭐ The old parish priest dies, a Canon Franceschi gives him the last blessing, and a Vicar General of Pedena buries him
⭐⭐⭐ «TEXTOR EX CARNIA» — the parish register says it, in 1773, of a named man
⭐⭐ «1783. Sterilis et fames» — the priest headed the year, and the 1773 that should hold Leonardus holds nobody
⭐⭐⭐ The archpriest of Krbune came back to bury her — and the register unmakes three things this archive published yesterday
⭐⭐⭐ The župan's widow, dead at ninety and buried inside the church — and the arithmetic of the direct line does not survive her
⭐⭐ The parish numbered its own registers, and the covers say which book is missing
⭐⭐⭐ A numbered list of every house in the village, dated by its own strikings to 1 July 1770 — and the Defranceschi are at 45 and 46
⭐⭐⭐ A perpetual calendar of this parish's dead — never opened, and it gave up eleven Defranceschi in a day
⭐⭐⭐ 10 November 1783, at Bakar, in her father's house — the wedding this archive has been missing for a week
⭐⭐⭐ The marriage this walk went looking for is not in this book — and the archive has been holding it on another page for a week
⭐⭐ The priest of this surname was in this parish from 1768 — and here he is writing his own name
⭐⭐⭐ Twelve years with no child — the gap is in the family, not in the registers
